title: SessionComputeTiming
description: One Session's final Compute allocation and Inference call timing.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

final_allocation.description: The allocation with the latest `occurred_at`: the arm the compute report groups this Session under.

allocation_changed.description: True when the Session's allocations carry more than one arm, so its timing covers more than one allocation.

allocations.description: Every visible Compute allocation for the Session, in `occurred_at` order.

inference_calls.description: Visible Inference calls in the Session; each carries `duration_ms`.

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds from the earliest call start to the latest call end.

model_ms.description: Sum of call durations. Parallel calls can make it exceed `elapsed_ms`.

between_calls_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds with no Inference call in flight: tool execution, harness work, and waiting. Not tool time alone.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

allocation_source.description: Who chose the allocation. Only `randomized` supports a causal comparison; every other source is observational.

cpu_millicores.description: CPU limit in millicores; 1000 is one CPU. Null means the sender reported no CPU limit, never zero.

memory_bytes.description: Memory limit in bytes. Null means the sender reported no memory limit, never zero.

allocation_id.description: Stable id for this Compute allocation fact.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

allocation_source.description: Who chose the allocation. Only `randomized` supports a causal comparison; every other source is observational.

cpu_millicores.description: CPU limit in millicores; 1000 is one CPU. Null means the sender reported no CPU limit, never zero.

memory_bytes.description: Memory limit in bytes. Null means the sender reported no memory limit, never zero.

occurred_at.description: When the allocation took effect, by the sender's clock. Derivations order a Session's allocations by it and never compare it with gateway-observed time.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
